new_findings: Board is B01 P3449, mainline has no B01 DTS (only p3450 A02 and p3541 2GB), so the first boot uses the p3450 DTB
Vendor stack exposes no /dev/dri: Hyprland cannot run on L4T; independent confirmation of ADR-001
Root is a single ext4 partition /dev/mmcblk0p1 with /boot inside it
eth0 has carrier and the r8168 driver but NetworkManager has no active profile, so there is no IPv4
